 The “ Afterlife With Archie ” series at Disney+ has found its Archie, Veronica, Betty, Jughead, and Sabrina the Teenage Witch.
 Archie Andrews will be played by Vasco Faria (“Your Fault: London”); Veronica Lodge will be played by Aliyah Mastin (“Paradise”); Sarah Abbott (“The Body”) will play Betty Cooper; Angel Rivera (“Escape from Mr. Lemoncello’s Library”) is Jughead Jones; and Sabrina Spellman will be played by Chloe Avakian (“Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy”).

 “Afterlife With Archie” is a live-action adaptation of the comic series written by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa. Aguirre-Sacasa (“Riverdale,” “Chilling Adventures of Sabrina”) serves as executive producer of the TV show with Greg Berlanti (“You,” “The Flash,” “The Flight Attendant”).
 Per the logline, “Afterlife With Archie” turns “the all-American town of Riverdale into a zombie-overrun apocalypse — where the only thing scarier than the undead is trying to survive your teenage years. When a supernatural spell from a certain teen-witch backfires, unleashing an army of the possessed dead upon Riverdale, Archie and his friends must fight to stay alive, testing the friendships, romances, and loyalties that have always held them together.”
 The “Afterlife With Archie” comics served as a major creative inspiration behind the hit CW series “Riverdale.” The two projects share the same group of characters, but “Archie” is a less grounded, more horror-influenced take.
 Jimmy Gibbons also executive produces the show via Muckle Man Productions alongside Sarah Schechter, Leigh London Redman (via Berlanti Productions and its overall deal with WBTV) and Jon Goldwater (Archie Comics Studios). Alfonso Gomez-Rejon will direct the pilot and second episode, and he will also serve as executive producer on both episodes.
 Deadline broke the news.
